_note: Income of every kind chargeable under other sources and under no other head, not one of the kinds named for the head, in full (D-203). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.92(1) "Income of every kind which is not to be excluded from the total income under this Act, shall be chargeable to income-tax under the head "Income from other sources", if it is not chargeable to income-tax under any of the heads specified in section 13(a) to (d)" (p.137). TY 2025-26: 1961 s.56(1), "under any of the heads specified in section 14, items A to E", as enacted — its 1961 Gazette not found, as OS-INTEREST's and OS-OTHER-EXPENDITURE's. Every regime. Sources: docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-17-other-sources-rest.md. In RS-OS-INCOME, by othersources.kind, it also charges income from Mutual Fund units, family pension, commuted fund pension and a death gratuity received under this head: no clause of s.92(2) or 1961 s.56(2) names them, so s.92(1) / s.56(1) does; their deductions are OS-FAMILY-PENSION, OS-COMMUTED-PENSION and OS-DEATH-GRATUITY (sources/2026-10-22-unit-income.md U1 – U11; D-321).
